newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A2 to Honda Finance Euro CP.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A2 to Honda Finance Euro CP.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday that it had assigned its A2 rating to the Euro commercial paper programme of Honda Finance Europe Plc, a unit of Honda Motor Co Ltd.
At the same time, the A2 commercial paper ratings and A long-term ratings of Honda Motor and its related entities have been affirmed, S&P said in a statement.
Honda Finance benefits from the finance company's keepwell agreement with Honda, S&P said.
The outlook for the ratings is positive, it said.

The ratings reflect the consolidated strength of the Honda group, namely its competitive position in the global car market and its demonstrated ability to maintain acceptable financial performance amid difficult industry conditions, S&P said.

The ratings could be raised if Honda maintains its strong sales and financial performance despite an increasingly competitive domestic market and the potential for adverse changes in foreign exchange rates over the short to medium term, it said.
